source.title: Farewell Swift
source.source_text: NASA’s Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory reentered this morning, bringing the 22-year-old mission to an end. NASA contracted with Katalyst Space in September 2025 to revamp an existing system to try […]

responses.spoken: 美国航天局的尼尔·格雷尔斯·斯威夫特天文台今天上午再入大气层，这颗已运行22年的卫星任务随之结束。此前，航天局于2025年9月与Katalyst Space公司签约，改造一套现有系统。
quotes: NASA’s Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory reentered this morning, bringing the 22-year-old mission to an end.
NASA contracted with Katalyst Space in September 2025
